page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs, operating at a ratio of 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It does not feature any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, offering predictable processing capabilities for standard workloads.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m1.medium offers a standard resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads. It is designed for applications that require steady CPU performance without the need for specialized hardware accelerators or high-speed local NVMe drives. Typical workloads for this instance profile include mid-sized web servers, application hosting, containerized microservices, and development environments.
